data.title: Accident not recognised as work accident
data.summary: Unfallkasse Musterland wrote on 12 December 2024 that your accident of 4 November 2024 is not recognised as an insured commuting accident (Wegeunfall). You may object (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The accident insurer decided that your fall in the supermarket on 4 November 2024 is not an insured accident, because you had interrupted your way to work for a private shopping trip. Treatment costs are therefore billed to your health insurer. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or on record at the Unfallkasse. The app shows until when the objection must arrive. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. Consider getting advice, for example from a union or social-law counsellor, if you want to contest it.

key_facts.label: Accident date (Unfall vom)
key_facts.quote: Ihr Unfall vom 04.11.2024 – keine Anerkennung als Arbeitsunfall

key_facts.label: Reason
key_facts.value: Commute interrupted for private shopping; § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 SGB VII
key_facts.quote:
Der Unfall ist
deshalb kein versicherter Wegeunfall im Sinne des § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 SGB VII.

items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) deadline
items.action: File a written objection (Widerspruch) or declare it on record at the Unfallkasse if you disagree with the decision.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final if no objection arrives in time.
items.quote:
Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur
Niederschrift erreichen (Unfallkasse Musterland, Postfach 11 22, 35001 Musterbergen).
